records.jp: ねーねー。<CR>そろそろ決めない？
records.en_original: So what's our next move?
records.en: So what's our next move?

records.jp: 何を？
records.en_original: What are you talking about?
records.en: What are you talking about?

records.jp: 次のイタズラ
records.en_original: Our next prank.
records.en: Our next prank.

records.jp: いーねぇ
records.en_original: Oooh, I like the way you think.
records.en: Oooh, I like the way you think.

records.jp: うむ。そろそろ詩帆たちも忘れた頃だろう
records.en_original: Yes, they won't expect a thing.
records.en: Yes, they won't expect a thing.

records.jp: あたしあれいいと思うんだよね。<CR>寝てる間にベッド動かすやつ
records.en_original: I think we should do the one where we move someone's bed somewhere while they're sleeping.
records.en: I think we should do the one where we move someone's bed somewhere while they're sleeping.

records.jp: びっくりするだろうなぁ。<CR>起きたとき自分が中庭にいたら
records.en_original: Wouldn't it be crazy to wake up and you're in the courtyard?
records.en: Wouldn't it be crazy to wake up and you're in the courtyard?

records.jp: 運べるのか？
records.en_original: Can we carry a bed that far?
records.en: Can we carry a bed that far?

records.jp: 四人いればいけるっしょ。<CR>他なんかいい案ある？　陽桜莉
records.en_original: With four people, sure. Do you have any other ideas, Hiori?
records.en: With four people, sure. Do you have any other ideas, Hiori?

records.jp: うーん、何にもない日なのに盛大に祝うとか？<CR>ケーキとかクラッカーとか準備して
records.en_original: Hmmm. Why don't we throw a giant party on a random normal day.
records.en: Hmmm. Why don't we throw a giant party on a random normal day.

records.jp: え、何の日？　ってなったとこでネタばらし。<CR>何もなくても嫌な気分にはならないと思うな
records.en_original: Then we reveal that it's not actually a holiday or birthday at all! That way no one gets any hurt feelings.
records.en: Then we reveal that it's not actually a holiday or birthday at all! That way no one gets any hurt feelings.

records.jp: 陽桜莉は本当にいい人だねぇ。<CR>うっ、うっ……
records.en_original: Oh, Hori, you're so sweet... *Sniff*...
records.en: Oh, Hori, you're so sweet... *Sniff*...

records.jp: きららは何かいいのある？
records.en_original: What about you, Kirara?
records.en: What about you, Kirara?

records.jp: リアル金縛りチャレンジ
records.en_original: The Sleep-Paralysis Challenge.
records.en: The Sleep-Paralysis Challenge.

records.jp: 何それ？
records.en_original: What's that?
records.en: What's that?

records.jp: 寝ている人の上に乗って何分で起きるか競う。<CR>払い落されても耐えた人の勝ち
records.en_original: You climb on top of someone while they're sleeping and see how long it takes them to wake up.
records.en: You climb on top of someone while they're sleeping and see how long it takes them to wake up.

records.jp: それってドッキリとは微妙にちがくない？
records.en_original: Is that really any different from just waking someone up?
records.en: Is that really any different from just waking someone up?

records.jp: いいや。乗っている人のなりきり度が大事。<CR>中途半端は金縛りに失礼
records.en_original: No, the person on top has to commit to the part. No one likes a half-hearted sleep-paralysis demon.
records.en: No, the person on top has to commit to the part. No one likes a half-hearted sleep-paralysis demon.

records.jp: たしかに本気でやったら脅かせそうだなぁ。<CR>こころは？
records.en_original: If you acted the part it could be pretty freaky... What do you think, Kokoro?
records.en: If you acted the part it could be pretty freaky... What do you think, Kokoro?

records.jp: （こころってあんまりイタズラのイメージないよな。<CR>前回は遠征行ってたから参加してなかったし）
records.en_original: (Kokoro doesn't really seem to be the prankster type. She wasn't around for the last time either.)
records.en: (Kokoro doesn't really seem to be the prankster type. She wasn't around for the last time either.)

records.jp: わたしは入れ替わりドッキリとか面白いと思うな
records.en_original: I think it would be funny if we pretended we switched bodies.
records.en: I think it would be funny if we pretended we switched bodies.

records.jp: たとえば、わたしが愛央ちゃんと入れ替わった<CR>ってことにして、それぞれがお互いを演じるの
records.en_original: Like, if I acted like Ao and she acted like me.
records.en: Like, if I acted like Ao-chan and she acted like me.

records.jp: みんなには隠してる感じにして、<CR>勇希ちゃんたちには気づかないふりしてもらう
records.en_original: And have Yuki and everyone else just carry on like nothing's changed.
records.en: And have Yuki-chan and everyone else just carry on like nothing's changed.

records.jp: もしかして入れ替わってる？　<CR>って聞かれたら、ドッキリ大成功
records.en_original: Then if someone asks if I'm you or vice versa we reveal the prank.
records.en: Then if someone asks if I'm you or vice versa we reveal the prank.

records.jp: （結構しっかり考えてるじゃん……）
records.en_original: (That's surprisingly thought-out...)
records.en: (That's surprisingly thought-out...)

records.jp: 愛央はどう？<CR>誰のがいいとかあった？
records.en_original: What do you think, Ao? Which idea do you like best?
records.en: What do you think, Ao? Which idea do you like best?

records.jp: きららのがいいと思う。<CR>伶那さんあたりにうってつけ
records.en_original: I like Kirara's idea. Rena would be the perfect victim.
records.en: I like Kirara's idea. Rena-san would be the perfect victim.

records.jp: ふっふっふ。本物そっくりに演じてみせよう
records.en_original: Hehehe. I'll show her the real deal.
records.en: Hehehe. I'll show her the real deal.

records.jp: わー、楽しみ！
records.en_original: Woohoo! I can't wait!
records.en: Woohoo! I can't wait!

records.jp: （え、本物？）
records.en_original: (Wait, the real deal?)
records.en: (Wait, the real deal?)

records.jp: あの小娘は白装束だったか
records.en_original: I believe the last time I saw mine she long black hair and a white dress...
records.en: I believe the last time I saw mine she long black hair and a white dress...

records.jp: （……聞かなかったことにしよう）
records.en_original: (...I don't wanna know.)
records.en: (...I don't wanna know.)

records.jp: こころのがいいと思う
records.en_original: I like Kokoro's idea.
records.en: I like Kokoro's idea.

records.jp: やった。<CR>愛央ちゃんが賛成してくれて嬉しい
records.en_original: Yay! I'm glad you liked it, Ao.
records.en: Yay! I'm glad you liked it, Ao-chan.

records.jp: これ、ネタばらし前にしっかり泳がせるのが<CR>大事だと思うの
records.en_original: We have to make sure that we stick to our characters so they don't get suspicious.
records.en: We have to make sure that we stick to our characters so they don't get suspicious.

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃんだったらどんな反応するかな～ふふ
records.en_original: I can't wait to see how Shiho will react, hehe...
records.en: I can't wait to see how Shiho-chan will react, hehe...

records.jp: （こころって意外と……<CR>いけない、何かに目覚めるとこだった）
records.en_original: (This is bad... I think we've awoken something inside Kokoro.)
records.en: (This is bad... I think we've awoken something inside Kokoro.)

records.jp: 勇希のがいいと思う。<CR>早朝ドッキリは定番だよね
records.en_original: I like Yuki's idea. It's a classic.
records.en: I like Yuki's idea. It's a classic.

records.jp: わかるー？<CR>一回やってみたかったんだ
records.en_original: Right?! I've always wanted to try it once.
records.en: Right?! I've always wanted to try it once.

records.jp: あ、でも日菜子とかってトレーニングで<CR>結構早い時間に起きてるよね
records.en_original: Ahh, but Hinako and the others get up pretty early for training.
records.en: Ahh, but Hinako and the others get up pretty early for training.

records.jp: それより早く起きなきゃいけないのか。<CR>しんど……
records.en_original: Which means we'd have to wake up even earlier. This is gonna be rough...
records.en: Which means we'd have to wake up even earlier. This is gonna be rough...

records.jp: いやでも楽しいことには代えられない！<CR>頑張って起きるぞー！
records.en_original: But there's no substitute for fun! I'll make sure I wake up!
records.en: But there's no substitute for fun! I'll make sure I wake up!

records.jp: ここまで情熱かけてくれるなら、<CR>かけられた方も悪い気しないと思うよ
records.en_original: I'm sure when they see how hard we worked for our prank, they won't get mad at us.
records.en: I'm sure when they see how hard we worked for our prank, they won't get mad at us.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんのいいと思う。<CR>ネタばらししても怒られなさそうだし
records.en_original: I like Hiori's idea. This way no one has to get any hurt feelings.
records.en: I like Hiori-san's idea. This way no one has to get any hurt feelings.

records.jp: イタズラって色々あると思うけど、<CR>たまにはこういうのもアリかなって
records.en_original: There are a lot of different kinds of pranks, but something like this is good every once in a while.
records.en: There are a lot of different kinds of pranks, but something like this is good every once in a while.

records.jp: まぁ、何もなくてもお姉ちゃんとかみんなに<CR>ありがとうって言いたかっただけだけどね
records.en_original: Even if the prank doesn't work, I wanted to give back to my sister and the others.
records.en: Even if nothing happens, I just wanted to thank Onee-chan and everyone.

records.jp: 普段いっぱい色んなことしてもらってるから
records.en_original: They always do so much for me.
records.en: They always do so much for me.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは本当にいい人だねぇ。<CR>うっ、うっ……
records.en_original: Oh, Hiori, you're so sweet... *Sniff*...
records.en: Oh, Hiori-san, you're so sweet... *Sniff*...

records.jp: あはは、勇希ちゃんと同じ反応してる
records.en_original: Ahaha, you sound exactly like Yuki.
records.en: Ahaha, you sound exactly like Yuki-chan.
